newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds end firm, focus remains on U.S..
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds end firm, focus remains on U.S..

text.p: 1440 GMT - Austrian bonds staged a strong finish on Tuesday after the release of better-than-expected U.S. inflation indicators. "That's given us a real boost," said a trader.
Traders said the market was likely to consolidate gains over the next few days, investors seen eyeing Friday's U.S. jobless data for fresh clues.
* New 10 year benchmark 5.75 pct bond maturing July 2006 up five bps at 98.85 to yield 5.90 (5.91) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.21/29 to yield 5.86/84.
* Latest five-year 4.375 bond maturing February 2002 closed steady at 98.30 in bourse trade to yield 4.77 pct, quoted post-market at 98.48/56 to yield 4.73/71 percent.
* Austrian bond future up 50 bps at 108.05 on turnover of 463 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at three bps, five-year spread up one at 13 bps.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.438 and overnight money at 3.16/3.41.
